issues_in: Minor traceability: capacity_notes claims 'WPTA reports 179 diesel generators could generate 527.52 MW if operated' citing the 2025-10-08 WPTA article, which appears only in NOTES.
fixed: Added the WPTA/21Alive 2025-10-08 article URL (https://www.21alivenews.com/2025/10/08/public-hearing-set-googles-diesel-generator-plan-fort-wayne-data-center/) to data.json sources.public_urls so the capacity_notes claim ('179 diesel generators could generate 527.52 MW if operated') is traceable in the data entry itself, not only in NOTES.md.
Added a dated fix note to the NOTES.md 2026-08-11 section documenting the source addition and the URL.
remaining_risks: No data.json top-level `verified` flag exists while NOTES.md 2026-08-11 states verified: false; this was not part of the listed issue for this center, so left untouched for parent decision.
The 527.52 MW figure is backup/emergency generation scale only (per NOTES.md), not IT critical load; capacity_mw correctly remains null - no change made.
summary: Fixed the traceability gap for usdc-0100 by adding the WPTA 2025-10-08 article URL (verified live, HTTP 200) to data.json sources.public_urls so capacity_notes is source-backed, and documented the swap in NOTES.md's 2026-08-11 section. data.json validated as well-formed JSON after the edit.
